writer_cases.name: climbed_back_row_is_retired_and_recorded
writer_cases.why: The lane grew a/index.html from 800B past its 1000B ceiling. The row must leave routes, land in retired with the recovered size, and the summary counts must follow; b/index.html, still below, must be untouched.

writer_cases.name: still_below_row_is_left_alone
writer_cases.why: A ratchet may only tighten. A route still below its maximum is not touched, and a writer that rewrites an unchanged list would be a mutation with no cause.

writer_cases.name: empty_list_hard_fails
writer_cases.why: An empty routes array examines nothing. Exiting 0 over it would let a truncated or never-measured list read as "every page is at its maximum".

writer_cases.name: nothing_on_disk_hard_fails
writer_cases.why: A list whose pages are all absent measured nothing; that is UNKNOWN, not clean, and must not be reported as "none climbed back".

writer_cases.name: missing_list_hard_fails
writer_cases.why: No list means no ratchet. The writer must refuse rather than create an empty one.

writer_cases.name: moot_justification_is_retired_floors_untouched
writer_cases.why: grew/ is back above its floor: its licence is moot and leaves. same/ still reproduces: kept. lower/ is below floor at a size the licence does not name: a NEW shrink, kept so the guard fails on it. other/ grew, and its floor must NOT rise - this mode is not the rise-only floor update.

writer_cases.name: baseline_with_nothing_to_measure_hard_fails
writer_cases.why: No floors, or floors with no page on disk, measured nothing; the writer must refuse rather than report "none moot".
